document.name: Warriors Sports Club Taekwondo
document.shortDescription: Warriors Sports Club runs weekday and Saturday Taekwondo classes in Kingsbridge for ages 4-17, with after-school youth slots and older teen/adult evening training.
document.longDescription:
Warriors Sports Club's official Taekwondo page describes a Kingsbridge Bronx program focused on discipline, confidence, respect, focus, and fitness. The page publishes a class schedule with weekday youth sessions for ages 4-6 from 4:00 PM to 5:00 PM Monday through Friday, ages 7-10 from 5:00 PM to 6:00 PM Mondays through Fridays, and ages 10-17 from 6:00 PM to 7:00 PM Monday through Friday.

The same official schedule adds Saturday youth classes from 12:00 PM to 1:00 PM for ages 4-9 and 1:00 PM to 2:00 PM for ages 10-17, while adult classes run Tuesdays and Thursdays from 7:00 PM to 8:30 PM. The page lists Warriors Sports Club at 260 W 231st Street, Bronx, NY 10463 with phone 718-812-7087 and email info@warriorssportsclub.com.

Sources: https://warriorssportsclub.com/taekwondo https://warriorssportsclub.com/lib/vmw3lb/5-lxg4ksig.png
